about: Houses and cooperatives: the families that outlive Cargo 1. The mining quest line becomes the Rockwarden cooperative (the wiki's Rockwardens, three generations later in Cargo 3); the research quest line becomes the founding of House Rostrom and the fourth test of the Bekkenheim drive, flown by Dharr Santor. Both quest lines were declared in the game and never offered.

anselm.about: three tugs, a grudge against ore brokers; grandfather of Maret Rockwarden

ysolde.about: junior researcher in Cargo 1; founds House Rostrom (later CONZE, wiki canon)

santor.about: engineer; flies the fourth Bekkenheim test; the drive carries his name

aela.about: AEL-series asteroid boring agrobot; opens the Rockwardens' new claim, then asks whether it is in the cooperative

rockwarden_share.about: the captain holds a share in the Rockwarden cooperative

rockwarden_books.about: the captain kept the cooperative's books while Stonewright flew sublight

fourth_test_to_rostrom.about: the captain gave the only recording of the fourth test to {ysolde.short}

fourth_test_copy.about: the captain kept a copy of the fourth test recording

rostrom_creditor.about: House Rostrom was founded on the captain's loan

aela_member.about: {aela} became a member of the Rockwarden cooperative: the first machine shareholder

mine.aela.title: Who the gallery is for
text: The cooperative leases an AEL-series boring agrobot to open its new claim. {aela} digs the first gallery in a week, shores it, lights it, and then stops and asks who the gallery is for.
'For the cooperative,' {anselm.short} says. {aela} asks whether it is in the cooperative. {anselm.short} looks at you. You hold a share; it is partly your call.

questline.mining.1.title: A share in the rock
questline.mining.1.text: {anselm} runs three tugs and a grudge against ore brokers. He offers you a share in his cooperative for one platform's output, paid in rock.

questline.mining.2.title: Stonewright
questline.mining.2.text: The cooperative buys a hull to live in between claims. {anselm.short} names it Stonewright and asks you to haul the keel plates from Epsilon. 'Rock is patient,' he says. 'Brokers are not. So we will be rock.'

questline.mining.3.title: The long run
questline.mining.3.text: {anselm.short} takes Stonewright on the sublight run to the Fomalhaut belt: twenty-five light-years, decades for everyone who stays behind, far fewer for the crew. He asks you to keep the cooperative's books until his children can. They are three and five.

questline.research.1.title: Drive parts for Rostrom
questline.research.1.text: {ysolde} is a junior researcher with a senior budget problem. She needs Bekkenheim coil sections moved from Nova Labs to the Quantum Center without anyone weighing them.

questline.research.2.title: The fourth test
text: The first three Bekkenheim drive tests destroyed three empty hulls. The fourth has a pilot: {santor}, an engineer who would rather fly it than explain it to the board again. {ysolde.short} asks you to watch from a safe distance and record everything.
The hull vanishes. Eleven minutes later it is back, slightly off course. {santor.short} climbs out with three weeks of beard and will not say where he has been.

choices.say: Give it to her, and keep a copy

questline.research.3.title: House Rostrom
questline.research.3.text: {ysolde.short} buys the drive patents from her own institute with money borrowed from you. She calls the result House Rostrom. You call it a loan.

researcher_exchange.1.title: Logs for credits
researcher_exchange.1.text: A Rostrom recruiter offers research credits for copies of your navigation logs. Only the legs where your instruments misbehaved.
